synthetic.labelRule: the reply echoes at least 2 distinct tokens of the input — a documented CONTENT property, so the comparison measures the representations' ability to discriminate a known function of the tokens
synthetic.status: CONTROLLED SYNTHETIC — mechanism fixtures, never real-world evidence

real.labelRule: confidence >= 0.7 AND accepted (the production rule, read from the entry)
real.trainingWindow: the last K_MAX=20 entries in time order (the production window, RealSleepScheduler.runInduction)
real.note: runtime data, not part of the repository; referenced by path and hash. The distinct 256-bit feature count is measured by the harness, not here.

leakage.syntheticToReal: none: the two splits share no episode text (asserted by the harness)
leakage.trainToValidationToTest: disjoint by construction (seeded stride), asserted by the harness

whatThisIsNot: It is not a claim that the synthetic episodes measure the production distribution, and it is not a held-out real evaluation; the real split is the running gateway's log by reference.
